label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/path-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is Paths.get("/data/" + param) where param is user-controlled input from request.getParameter("BenchmarkTest"). Although a regex check against a deploy-time init parameter exists, the configuration content is unknown and cannot be proven to block path traversal sequences (e.g., ../). The sink expression directly incorporates unvalidated user input into the file path, creating a path traversal vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input param is retrieved and concatenated into file path for Files.readAllBytes
